items.title: Lillie Delk Christian Interview, 1961-04-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...May Alex was a schoolgirl then... [INTERVIEWEE] Amateurs?

ctx.x: Nightclub. Now, this goes back to maybe the years maybe before you were in Chicago. When did you come into Chicago?
Oh, good. I was here before the dreamland. So, I'm thinking that is really the time that May Alex started...
